evidence: Adds script evaluation trace APIs and hooks directly to libbitcoinkernel (`src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.{h,cpp}`, `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h`, and kernel unit tests).
rationale: The PR adds an optional build-time execution tracing API to libbitcoinkernel to support script debuggers and fine-grained interpreter state analysis. While it provides clear value and a working use case demonstrated by the author's proof-of-concept debugger and community tooling, it is an optional debugging tool rather than core library functionality, making it reasonably deferrable.
